records.text: Paul Tergat, Kenyan long-distance runner, was born on June 17, 1969.
records.textJa: Paul Tergat（Kenyan long-distance runner）は1969年6月17日に生まれた。

records.text: On March 16, 1975, the 1975 IAAF World Cross Country Championships took place in Souissi, won by Ian Stewart and Julie Brown.
records.textJa: 1975年3月16日、1975 IAAF World Cross Country Championshipsが行われた（Souissi）。勝者はIan Stewart and Julie Brown。

records.birthPlace: Chepsamo, Chepkorio, Rift Valley Province, Kenya
records.text: Geoffrey Kipsang Kamworor, Kenyan long-distance runner, was born on November 22, 1992.
records.textJa: Geoffrey Kipsang Kamworor（Kenyan long-distance runner）は1992年11月22日に生まれた。

records.winnerName: Jakob Asserson Ingebrigtsen and Karoline Bjerkeli Grøvdal
records.text: On December 12, 2021, the 2021 European Cross Country Championships took place in Dublin, won by Jakob Asserson Ingebrigtsen and Karoline Bjerkeli Grøvdal.
records.textJa: 2021年12月12日、2021 European Cross Country Championshipsが行われた（Dublin）。勝者はJakob Asserson Ingebrigtsen and Karoline Bjerkeli Grøvdal。

records.winnerName: Yann Schrub and Karoline Bjerkeli Grøvdal
records.text: On December 10, 2023, the 2023 European Cross Country Championships took place at Laeken Park, won by Yann Schrub and Karoline Bjerkeli Grøvdal.
records.textJa: 2023年12月10日、2023 European Cross Country Championshipsが行われた（Laeken Park）。勝者はYann Schrub and Karoline Bjerkeli Grøvdal。

records.text: On March 30, 2024, the 2024 World Athletics Cross Country Championships took place at Park of Friendship.
records.textJa: 2024年3月30日、2024 World Athletics Cross Country Championshipsが行われた（Park of Friendship）。

records.winnerName: Jakob Asserson Ingebrigtsen and Nadia Battocletti
records.text: On December 8, 2024, the 2024 European Cross Country Championships took place in Antalya, won by Jakob Asserson Ingebrigtsen and Nadia Battocletti.
records.textJa: 2024年12月8日、2024 European Cross Country Championshipsが行われた（Antalya）。勝者はJakob Asserson Ingebrigtsen and Nadia Battocletti。

records.text: On December 14, 2025, the 2025 European Cross Country Championships took place in Lagoa.
records.textJa: 2025年12月14日、2025 European Cross Country Championshipsが行われた（Lagoa）。
